Task PM_POWER_B2_I02: x_(t+1)=(5*x_t+9) mod 23; x_0=18. Find x_47.
Checked child records from earlier tasks in this block: []

To find \( x_{47} \) for the recurrence relation \( x_{t+1} = (5x_t + 9) \mod 23 \) with \( x_0 = 18 \), I will first check if there are any reusable records that cover more than one step. Since no reusable records are available, I will directly compute the sequence up to \( x_{47} \).

Starting with \( x_0 = 18 \):
\[
x_1 = (5 \cdot 18 + 9) \mod 23 = 99 \mod 23 = 10
\]
\[
x_2 = (5 \cdot 10 + 9) \mod 23 = 59 \mod 23 = 13
\]
\[
x_3 = (5 \cdot 13 + 9) \mod 23 = 74 \mod 23 = 15
\]
\[
x_4 = (5 \cdot 15 + 9) \mod 23 = 84 \mod 23 = 16
\]
\[
x_5 = (5 \cdot 16 + 9) \mod 23 = 91 \mod 23 = 2
\]
\[
x_6 = (5 \cdot 2 + 9) \mod 23 = 19 \mod 23 = 19
\]
\[
x_7 = (5 \cdot 19 + 9) \mod 23 = 104 \mod 23 = 18
\]

Notice that \( x_7 = 18 \), which is the same as \( x_0 \). This indicates a cycle starting from \( x_0 \) with a period of 7. Therefore, \( x_{47} \) can be determined by finding the position of 47 within the cycle:
\[
47 \mod 7 = 5
\]
Thus, \( x_{47} = x_5 = 2 \).
